label: Horizontal support for concurrent actualization: momentary PSR and time symmetry
summary: Note docs/notes/ca-horizontal-support.md; module TruthCore.Causality.TimeSymmetricGiving, spec specs/time-symmetric-giving.toml. Horizontal test of weak concurrent actualization 40a97664 from families other than the Thomist esse/act-potency family. (1) PSR family at matching time-indexed scope: re-read Schmid 2021 (SCHMID-INERTIA-REPLY-3-ARTICLE): the PSR-like principle he accepts is Feser's auxiliary thesis that something must explain an object's continuing to exist; he rejects the thesis that without a sustaining cause there is no extrinsic explanation. Typed as the momentary PSR 9a14bdd8 (primitive explanation relation, definition 261516e9; extended by the analyst from continuation to every moment of presence) and the productive bridge d86c9de9 (any explanation comes with a giver; the second thesis together with Feser's denial of an intrinsic explanation). Schmid's explanation is the defined origin-or-inertia sense (definition 8c20c988). Result psrBridgeCarriesTheCrux (2b8b48d1): for every interpretation, under the momentary PSR the bridge is equivalent to 40a97664; concurrentOfMomentaryPSR (c186cee4) is a transcription. Inertia satisfies the momentary PSR in eternal and begun histories (controls f49ba264 parts 1, 4). Classification (c). (2) Routes to GOD_4: 40a97664 is an open premise of none of the 15 routes; 2068f91c appears in 7 and keeps its direct option; 3ef67739 appears in 4 (1c154f2f, 72391d4d, 0a639ec4, fc46b7f9) and on its strict sustaining reading has inertia as its recorded standing rival (causal-dependence-support-investigation.md, rival row 3). Six routes (prima via ed7c588a, quarta via 5d2b7c6e, 678ff65f, 661ce61d, and fd1f7e75, beec1dc1) contain neither, and no recorded rival table lists inertia against their premises. A2ab's originating derivation is recorded inertia-acceptable only on the inclusive reading of GivesAt. Classification (b) for six routes. (3) Leibnizian contrastive principle: coverage 4bc853db (whatever has received esse has its being caused by another, tenseless), exercise 7005560a (a cause of another's being gives it being at some moment of its presence) and time symmetry 488263b0 (order automorphisms of time preserving presence and the supplied non-giving facts preserve giving; after Leibniz's sourced temporal-shift argument 2bd8f0e3) give 40a97664 for homogeneous things eb928359 (result 4f0c026d, not a transcription; one cause gives at every moment). 40a97664 entails eb928359 (76dc5abc, relation 7bb5ce58, strict by Control part 4). Controls: each premise needed (eternal inertia, arbitrary-moment giver, unexercised cause); begun inertia satisfies all three while 40a97664 fails, and in that control an automorphism preserving the begun thing's presence fixes its first moment, so the symmetry step is idle there and the bundle is not parity restated. Classification (a) as an entailment, scoped and partly horizontal: only time symmetry is from another family; coverage and exercise are esse-family premises. In the homogeneous beginningless case the result relocates the dispute from per-moment giving to tenseless coverage for beginningless things (the tenseless Avicennian core), which has its own tenseless De ente argument and is accepted by the rival for begun things but restricted on the same change-only rationale that rejects 40a97664; a general extrinsic inertialist must give up, for such a possible thing, a cause of its being as a whole (Hume-Edwards analogue), time symmetry (Clarke 81ec01fe, noncontrastive explanation e35adb5f), or exercise. Conditional on the possibility of such a thing (leads only; Leibniz's relationalism in 2bd8f0e3 presses against it). (4) Avicennian preponderance: unread lead; its per-moment form is parity re-presented (c), its tenseless core coincides with coverage for beginningless things. Scotist essential order: no record, unread; (b) for God-relevance, (c) for CA. Grounding and dependence: composites' synchronic dependence is shared and relocates to simples; Feser's constituent argument is 40a97664 restated for composites; DependsForBeing presupposes it (c). Physics: neutral (c). truth countermodel does not support the Preorder/OrderIso binders; controls are hand-written over integer time. Independent semantic challenge of 05a50e749 found 4 P1 (an unrecorded inertia rival on 3ef67739 routes, a dropped inclusive-reading qualifier on A2ab, coverage's warrant independence overstated, a false strength claim between exercise and concurrence) and 12 P2 findings, all repaired in the following commit.
blocker: The actual-world crux is unchanged: actual persisting things are not in homogeneous histories, so the symmetry result is silent on them, and no discriminating test at matching scope is available there. In the homogeneous case the result relocates rather than resolves the dispute: tenseless coverage for beginningless things against the change-only rationale. The scoped item depends on the possibility of a homogeneous beginningless received-esse thing (leads only: ST I q.46 a.2, Avicenna, stationary cosmologies; Leibniz's relationalism presses against it) and on coverage's modal scope. The caused-universe connection (CausingWholeCausesParts b08eee83 with temporal parts and an Ontic.Causes-to-GivesAt bridge) is unbuilt. Next test: type the change-only asymmetry as a constraint on which facts may distinguish moments for giving, and test whether a beginningless thing in a changing history can satisfy coverage and exercise with giving at changes only.

current_assessment.scope: Horizontal families bearing on weak concurrent actualization 40a97664: the momentary PSR (Schmid's accepted principle and the productive bridge), routes to GOD_4 with and without the crux, the Leibnizian contrastive principle over moments with coverage and exercise, and analyst classifications of Avicennian, Scotist, grounding and physics families. Side by side with, not replacing, the 2026-11-19 assessment of attempt 21883b61 and the 2026-11-18 cluster assessment of attempt 447838c8.
current_assessment.assessment: The CA dependency is avoidable for God's existence on six routes, not all: 40a97664 is an open premise of no route to GOD_4; six routes (prima via, quarta via and two others) contain neither 2068f91c nor 3ef67739 and no recorded rival table lists inertia against their premises (a support of their premise 09c6d5f0, 19882fa9, has inertia as a kept rival, avoided by the recorded bypass 5c5b794f); the crux enters four routes through 3ef67739 on its strict sustaining reading (inertia its recorded standing rival), and also the immensity presence step, the sustaining readings, one support option of 2068f91c and the holding First Way; A2ab's originating route is shown free of it only on the inclusive reading of GivesAt. The PSR family adds nothing at matching scope: the momentary PSR is shared in its continuation form, and under it the productive bridge is 40a97664 (checked for every interpretation). One partly horizontal item, scoped: coverage, exercise and time symmetry entail 40a97664 for homogeneous received-esse things; each is logically independent of 40a97664 and satisfied by inertia for begun things, but only time symmetry comes from another family. In the homogeneous beginningless case the result relocates the dispute from per-moment giving to tenseless coverage for beginningless things, a principle with its own tenseless argument that the rival accepts for begun things (if it counts the originator as a cause of being, not only of becoming) and restricts on the same change-only rationale on which it rejects 40a97664; a general extrinsic inertialist must there give up a cause of the thing's being as a whole (Hume-Edwards analogue), time symmetry, or exercise. The item is at modal scope, conditional on the possibility of such a thing (unassessed; Leibniz's relationalism presses against it), and silent on actual persisting things. The actual-world crux is unchanged; the grade of 40a97664 moves from 'both stand, one price item each' to 'both stand; the general form of extrinsic inertia must, in the eternal-stationary case, restrict a tenseless principle it accepts for begun things on that condition, or reject time symmetry or exercise': a relocation with a modest cost, not an independent defeat. Avicennian preponderance restates parity in its per-moment form and coincides with coverage in its tenseless core; Scotist essential order is unread; grounding and physics are neutral or presupposing. Nothing is established or defeated.
current_assessment.next_test: Extend the symmetry family to beginningless changing histories: type the change-only asymmetry as a constraint on which supplied facts may distinguish moments for giving, and test whether giving at changes only satisfies coverage and exercise without 40a97664. Separately, build the Ontic.Causes-to-GivesAt and temporal-part bridges for CausingWholeCausesParts (b08eee83).
